metaShifts.description: Complete removal of Kaya-based item stacking for both mana regen and spell lifesteal amplification across all items (Kaya, Y&K, K&S, Meteor Hammer). This directly counters the 7.37 Intelligence Core Renaissance by reducing the sustainability and spell amplification potential of intelligence cores who previously could stack multiple Kaya items for exponential benefits.

Systematic nerfs to remaining viable alternatives to strength cores: Ember Spirit heavily nerfed (Immolation damage reduced, no linger, SoF cooldown increased), Tinker mana costs increased, Viper Predator gutted, Ursa Maul scaling nerfed. Combined with buffs to traditional carries (Juggernaut, Faceless Void, Anti-Mage talents), this continues 7.37's strength core hegemony trend.

Targeted adjustments to overpowered support heroes from 7.37: Rubick intelligence and Fade Bolt mana nerfs, Abaddon Mist Coil scaling nerfs, Oracle Rain of Destiny damage reduced. Simultaneously, underperforming supports receive buffs (Warlock Fatal Bonds damage, Snapfire improvements, Muerta armor). This rebalances support tier lists without systemic changes.

synergisticWinners.synergyExplanation: Heroes like Juggernaut (base damage buff), Faceless Void (Time Lock damage buff), and Anti-Mage (talent improvements) benefit from the elimination of Kaya stacking because their primary threats - intelligence cores with massive spell lifesteal and mana sustainability - are now significantly weaker. The removal of spell lifesteal stacking makes these physical damage dealers more threatening in extended fights.

Magnus receives both base agility buff and new slow resistance on Solid Core (20/30/40/50%), while the meta shifts away from high-mobility intelligence cores. This creates a perfect storm where Magnus becomes more survivable against the remaining viable cores (mostly strength-based) while his initiation becomes more valuable as teams rely more on positioning than spell combinations.

Fatal Bonds damage increase (15/18/21/24% from 12/16/20/24%) combined with the elimination of spell lifesteal stacking creates longer, more sustained team fights where percentage-based damage becomes exponentially more valuable. Teams can no longer quickly heal through Fatal Bonds damage with stacked spell lifesteal.

synergisticLosers.synergyExplanation: Heroes like Invoker, Storm Spirit, and Lina who previously could build multiple Kaya-based items (Y&K + K&S for example) for exponential mana regen and spell lifesteal amplification now face severe sustainability issues. The removal of stacking directly counters the 7.37 Intelligence Core Renaissance, forcing these heroes back into inferior item builds.

The combination of Immolation damage nerfs (10/18/26/34 from 10/20/30/40), removal of linger duration, increased Sleight of Fist cooldowns, AND the elimination of Kaya stacking destroys both physical and magical Ember builds. Spell-based Ember can no longer sustain with stacked spell lifesteal, while physical Ember faces longer cooldowns and weaker farming.

Predator damage per missing health nerfed significantly (0.15 + 0.05 per level from 0.25 + 0.05), and illusion interaction changes make Viper weaker against the few remaining illusion heroes. This removes one of the key counters to Phantom Lancer and other illusion carries, indirectly buffing illusion strategies despite PL's own nerfs.

Carry.explanation: Base damage increase (+2) provides significant laning advantage and scales throughout the game. Benefits massively from Kaya stacking removal as intelligence cores who could previously out-sustain him in fights are now much weaker. Traditional right-click carry thrives in the post-spell-lifesteal meta.

Time Lock bonus damage buffed substantially (12/18/24/30 from 10/15/20/25), providing both better farming and team fight damage. The elimination of Kaya stacking means enemies have less spell lifesteal to survive through Chronosphere combos, making his ultimate significantly more lethal.

Level 10 talent Mana Void radius increased (+200 from +150) and Level 15 Persecutor slow improved (+15% from +10%). With intelligence cores weakened by Kaya nerfs, Anti-Mage's natural mana-burning advantage becomes more pronounced, and larger Mana Void radius provides better team fight impact.

Mid.explanation: Base agility buff (+3) improves attack speed and armor, while new slow resistance on Solid Core (20/30/40/50%) provides crucial survivability. Level 15 talent improvements make him scale better into late game. Thrives as intelligence cores are weakened and physical damage becomes more prevalent.

Puckish now provides flat 20 health/mana per dodge, significantly improving lane sustainability and team fight presence. With spell lifesteal stacking removed, Puck's natural elusiveness and sustain become more valuable relative to other mid heroes who relied on item-based sustain.

Offlane.explanation: Same benefits as mid Magnus but particularly strong in offlane where the slow resistance helps against common offlane harassment. The agility buff improves his traditionally weak laning phase, while talent improvements make him a more reliable late-game initiator.

Level 15 talent health increase (+300 from +275) provides better survivability in extended fights. Benefits from the meta shift away from high-burst intelligence cores toward more sustained physical damage, where his armor reduction becomes more valuable over time.

SoftSupport.explanation: Fatal Bonds damage increase (15/18/21/24% from 12/16/20/24%) is massive for team fights, while Shadow Word mana cost reduction and cooldown improvements enhance laning. The elimination of spell lifesteal stacking makes percentage-based damage exponentially more effective.

Firesnap Cookie damage buff (75/150/225/300 from 70/145/220/295) and Spit Out now applying Mortimer Kisses significantly improve her team fight contribution. Benefits from longer, more sustained fights where her area damage becomes more impactful.

HardSupport.explanation: Base armor increase (+1) significantly improves her fragile early game survivability, while The Calling mana cost reduction (140/155/170/185 from 145/160/175/190) allows for more frequent usage. Thrives in the post-Kaya meta where sustained fights favor her damage over time.

Level 25 talent Brain Sap improvement (+275 from +250) enhances his late-game impact. Benefits from the meta shift toward longer fights where his single-target lockdown and sustain become more valuable than burst-oriented supports.

Carry.explanation: Juxtapose illusion damage taken increased (625% from 650% - this is actually a buff to survivability, but the Illusory Armaments change where illusions only get 65% bonus damage conversion significantly weakens his scaling), combined with continued pressure from 7.37's illusion nerfs.

Level 10 talent Reflection cooldown reduction nerfed (5s from 4s), reducing his early game impact and farming efficiency. Suffers from the same anti-illusion meta trends that hurt Phantom Lancer, with fewer viable item builds due to Kaya stacking removal.

Mid.explanation: Devastating nerfs across the board: Immolation damage reduced (10/18/26/34 from 10/20/30/40), linger duration removed, Sleight of Fist cooldown increased (13/11/9/7 from 12/10/8/6), and multiple talent nerfs. Combined with Kaya stacking removal, both physical and magical builds are severely weakened.

Defense Matrix and March of the Machines mana cost increases significantly impact his farming efficiency and team fight sustainability. The removal of Kaya stacking eliminates his ability to achieve the mana regen necessary for constant spell spam, fundamentally altering his playstyle.

While receiving some QoL improvements (orbs don't break channeling/invisibility), the elimination of Kaya stacking destroys his late-game scaling potential. Previously could build Y&K + K&S for massive spell lifesteal and mana regen amplification, now forced into inferior item builds.

Offlane.explanation: Counter Helix radius decreased (275 from 300) significantly impacts his farming and team fight presence. Talent rework moves damage from Level 15 to Level 20, weakening his mid-game power spike when offlaners need to be most impactful.

Horsepower strength-to-movement speed conversion nerfed (30% from 35%), reducing his mobility and initiation potential. In a meta favoring sustained fights over quick engagements, this mobility loss is particularly damaging.

Momentum attack speed penalty increased (85 from 75), making his already clunky attack animation even more problematic. This significantly impacts his farming efficiency and team fight contribution in the early-to-mid game.

SoftSupport.explanation: Base intelligence decreased (-1) and Fade Bolt mana cost increased substantially (110/125/140/155 from 110/120/130/140), severely impacting his laning phase and spell spam potential. The Kaya stacking removal eliminates his late-game scaling through spell lifesteal.

Shadow Strike cast point improved from 0.4s to 0.3s is listed as a nerf, suggesting this makes the ability harder to use effectively (possibly animation timing issues). Combined with Kaya stacking removal, her spell-based builds become much weaker.

HardSupport.explanation: Multiple nerfs across the board: Mist Coil mana cost scaling (50/55/60/65 from 50), Level 10 talent Aphotic Shield regen reduced (+12 from +15), Level 15 talent Mist Coil heal/damage reduced (+35 from +40). These significantly impact his sustain and team fight contribution.

Rain of Destiny damage/heal per second decreased (35 from 40), reducing his ultimate's impact in team fights. In a meta moving toward sustained fights, this reduction in healing throughput is particularly damaging to his viability.

Level 10 talent damage decreased (+30 from +35), weakening her already limited damage contribution. The Kaya stacking removal also eliminates potential spell amplification builds that could have made her more relevant in the late game.
